map.ESN 号码验证器。输入 8 位十六进制电子序列号，校验格式与字符范围，用于旧式: ESN Number validator. Enter an 8-digit hexadecimal Electronic Serial Number; validate format and character range, for legacy CDMA device identity verification and inventory management (not a validity check).
map.依据 CDMA 电子序列号规则校验 8 位十六进制 ESN 的字符范围；用于旧式: Per CDMA ESN rules, validate the 8-hex-digit ESN's character range; for legacy device identity verification and inventory management (format check only, not authenticity).
map.CDMA 设备库存与维修场景核对电子序列号: Verify electronic serial numbers in CDMA device inventory and repair scenarios
map.输入 8 位十六进制（如 80A1B2C3）或对应的 11 位十进制形式，页面都: Enter 8 hex digits (e.g. 80A1B2C3) or the corresponding 11-decimal form; the page recognizes and validates the character range either way.
map.ESN 有几种表示形式？: How many representations does ESN have?
map.常见两种：8 位十六进制与 11 位十进制（首位常为 0），同一设备两种形式可互: Commonly two: 8 hex digits and 11 decimal digits (leading often 0); the two forms convert between each other for the same device.
map.ESN 是较旧的 32 位序列号（8 位 hex），MEID 是后续的 56 位: ESN is the older 32-bit serial (8 hex), MEID the later 56-bit (14 hex); different format and length.
map.校验通过代表设备合法吗？: Does passing validation mean the device is legal?
map.不代表。页面只校验格式，设备是否在网、是否报失须运营商数据库确认。: No. The page only checks format; whether the device is active or reported lost must be confirmed in the carrier database.
